path_basis: All file paths are relative to the standalone project root.

integrity.self_manifest_excluded_from_files: data/data_manifest.json is generated metadata and cannot contain its own checksum; every copied payload file is listed.

scientific_scope.model_weather: Native acquired daily weather arrays/files and provider-specific day definitions are retained unchanged in the model-ready data and scientific result assets.
scientific_scope.reference_climate: The complete 1981–2010 daily reference-grid series was never archived. Frozen qualified climatology, site climate tables, the Earth Engine response and acquisition/qualification receipts are supplied; no missing raw series has been fabricated or reacquired.
scientific_scope.climate_transfer_compact_parts: All six manifest-listed byte parts are retained. The untracked reassembled compact table is excluded; the original complete scientific table is present in the annual-temperature result asset.
scientific_scope.excluded_unrelated_sources: Original unrelated European/global collections, environment directories, Git metadata, caches and credentials are outside this bundle.
